visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown hair and a black pleated shirt sits at a wooden table in front of a laptop, gesturing with his hands while looking directly into the camera. The background is a bright, soft-lit room with a blurred green plant to the right. (2) The screen splits horizontally; in the top half, a blonde woman in a pink shirt sits on a dark sofa with a blurred green park background, gesturing as she speaks. The bottom half continues to show the man at his desk, nodding and looking at his laptop. (3) A cinematic shot of a subway train arriving at an underground station platform. A person in a grey coat and face mask stands in the foreground, facing the tracks. (4) A man with short dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and AirPods, sits in a room with a brick wall background, clapping his hands together and looking at a laptop screen. (5) The split-screen format returns, showing the blonde woman in the top frame and the man in the bottom frame, both engaged in an interview-style setup. (6) A screen recording of an iPhone interface appears, displaying a 'Hearing Test' interface with a circular blue waveform and instructions to 'Tap the Screen When You Hear a Tone.' (7) The split-screen returns with the woman explaining and the man listening intently. (8) A dual screen capture shows the iPhone 'Health' app tracking noise levels next to an Apple Watch displaying a green '54 dB' noise meter. (9) The final split-screen shot shows both speakers concluding their discussion, with the man looking up from his laptop toward the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你知道 AirPods 是怎樣「保護耳朵」的嗎？ [Logo]: @shasha77. (2) [Subtitle]: 今天讓我們一起來問問 Apple 的聽力主管. [Subtitle]: 你們在開發 AirPods Pro 的時候，有特別針對「聽力損傷」這一點做什麼調整嗎？ (3) [Subtitle]: 我們在 Apple Hearing Study 中發現，每三人就有一人，經常處於高音量的環境噪音中，長期下來可能影響聽力。 (4) [Subtitle]: 這類高音量環境，經常出現在日常生活裡，例如搭地鐵通勤，或參加各種活動。 (5) [Subtitle]: 為了減少日常高音量環境的影響，AirPods Pro 2 的「降低高音量」功能，能被動降低環境噪音。 (6) [Subtitle]: 更令人驚豔的是，它仍能保留使用者聆聽聲音的動態範圍。 (7) [Subtitle]: 讓大家在演唱會等情境中，依然享受自然又生動的現場音樂。 (8) [Subtitle]: 那如果懷疑自己聽力已經受損，有什麼可以做的嗎？ (9) [Subtitle]: 透過 AirPods Pro 2 搭配 iPhone 或 iPad，只要大約五分鐘，就能在家輕鬆完成聽力測試，並立即取得結果。 (10) [Subtitle]: 也能長期追踪測試數據，並提供給醫師參考，協助進一步診斷。 (11) [Subtitle]: Apple 團隊在工程、設計與聲學等面向，投入大量心力，重新思考軟體能解決哪些需求，並進一步提升 AirPods Pro 的健康與輔助使用功能。 (12) [Subtitle]: 因此我們很高興能推出全新功能，讓全台灣的使用者受益。
